messages:
ravi: FYI - Aurelia Systems wants a 2-week POC for their quartz-30b-lv model (customer-supplied weights). Requirements: private deployment (VPC), customer KMS, q4 quant if quality acceptable, and P95 latency <= 180ms for 256-token chat. Can Dedicated satisfy or do they need Private? blockers?

emma: We have a catalog stub for quartz-30b-lv but no validated q4 build. Biggest technical risk: tokenizer mismatch (they use a modified BPE with sentinel tokens) and a custom special-token mapping. Need tokenization parity test. Also confirm license permits hosting.

jorge: Perf quick take: on Dedicated with A100s we estimate ~170-200ms P95 at 256 tokens unbatched for non-quantized. Q4 could reduce latency but depends on kernel support. On Private depends on their GPU (if they have A100 or 4090-ish). Recommend KV prefix cache + single-request isolation for POC.

mei: Security: Private supports customer KMS and zero or configurable retention. Hosted can do reduced retention but not ideal for customer PHI. Also they'll want an SSA and our BAA signed. I'll start the sec questionnaire answers.

billing-bot: Created ticket BILL-9921: draft POC pricing + setup fee options (private vs dedicated) attached.

emma: Tokenizer test command: ./tools/tok_check --model quartz-30b-lv --ext-tokenizer aurelia_sp.model --prompts samples/100.json -> initial run shows 9/100 prompts mismatch around sentinel tokens. I can add an adapter normalizer; low risk.

jorge: I'll run a short perf smoke after tokenizer normalization. If q4 Triton artifact available we should smoke it on our Private image; otherwise produce a q8 fallback.

ravi: Commercial: offer 2-week Dedicated POC with optional Private onboarding (one-time setup). Call out possible quality delta with q4 quant in SOW. Emma, add license note for legal. Mei, please attach BAA status.

mei: Uploaded: aurelia_sec_q.pdf and BAA_draft_req.md to the POC folder.

ravi: Next steps checklist: 1) emma run tokenizer adapter and token-equivalence report; 2) jorge run perf (with/without KV) and attach P95 + cost estimates; 3) billing send POC quote; 4) mei finish sec questionnaire and BAA routing. Sync EOD tomorrow.

emma: Will push tokenizer patch today and re-run.

jorge: Perf note: if they accept a 150-token conversational cap we can hit <160ms P95 more reliably. I'll include that as an option.

ravi: Great. I'll schedule a 30m sync with Aurelia infra lead tomorrow. Thanks! :rocket:
